items.rationale: Concrete new release: Argus multi-agent platform inside Revit now builds fully parametric Revit families from scratch, plus ADA bathroom and MEP agents — directly changes BIM authoring work.
items.excerpt: BIMlogiq has expanded Argus, a multi-agent AI platform inside Revit, adding a Family Creation Agent that builds fully parametric Revit families from scratch, a Bathroom Agent for ADA-compliant layouts, and an MEP Systems Agent.

items.rationale: Immediately actionable: Photoshop's Remove tool does not burn generative credits even with cloud AI on, so designers can protect their monthly credit budget tomorrow.
items.excerpt: PHLEARN's Aaron Nace shows Photoshop's Remove tool doesn't consume generative credits even with Generative AI and cloud processing on, plus other overlooked features that preserve a designer's monthly AI credit budget.

items.rationale: Newly published Adobe patent filings for generating 3D worlds from text prompts signal Firefly's next step beyond image and video — an early heads-up for 3D and visualisation designers.
items.excerpt: Newly published USPTO patent filings show Adobe working on a method for generating 3D worlds from text prompts, hinting at where Firefly could expand beyond image and video generation.

items.rationale: Official Apple notice warning creators not to grant AI agents Full Disk Access on macOS, with new controls promised — a concrete security change for every designer running desktop agents.
items.excerpt: Apple issued a notice warning creators against granting AI agents Full Disk Access on macOS and promised new controls to address the critical risks.

items.rationale: Fresh designer-practice insight on skill atrophy and cognitive offloading — what designers stop practising when they hand judgement to AI; distinct angle from the published taste/great-designer pieces.
items.excerpt: AI is not making us less intelligent but reducing the intelligence we practise; the essay examines skill atrophy and cognitive offloading when designers outsource judgement and struggle to AI.
